summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric multiplayer action RPG with a shared playable realm and a solo Veil title/menu place. Place and actor scripts run quests, combat, bosses, services and ambience; shared Bearer/data modules support persistence and progression, while seeded procedural generators and authored placements dress its regions.
places: places/main/ - shared playable realm spanning Wayside Fire/Broken Lantern Road, Candlehold, Lanternmere, Hanging Orchard, Ashen Abbey, Ossuary, Hollow Deep and Frostbitten Vale; cells hold terrain, landmarks, actors and biome dressing.
places/veil/ - solo ephemeral title/menu stage and ravine backdrop, configured as default place; active Bearers are parked here while menus are open.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: defaultPlace veil; attaches player/camera templates, lighting, arrival/nametag behaviors, controls and audio mix.
templates/player.js - player body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child; templates/camera.js runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - main-realm atmosphere, terrain and authored biome cells; config attaches scripts/look-veilfall.js as its look.
places/main/sim.js - main-place referee: NPC/services, quest stages, enemy packs, progression, boss lifecycle/reset and place music/ambience.
places/veil/config.yaml, places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/sim.js - solo title/menu scene, ambience and menu soundtrack.
scripts/terrain.js - main realm height/material field; scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js defines connected regions and floor gates.
sim.js - world-level simulation entry; place-specific cadence/tick handlers live in places/*/sim.js.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player.js and arrival.js reuse it, crier/board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm/character and trade schemas, realm routing/name registry, and guild-vault SQL table/index setup.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml, economy.yml and loot.yml - shared enemy/boss profiles, drops/rewards and gear rules consumed by main sim, wax-pack and loot/combat/UI services.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body and BEARER map enemy kinds and six player callings to uploaded GLBs; main sim/wax-pack reuse enemy bodies and player.js selects calling body.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - chapter paths, region geometry, floor distances and zone naming used by terrain, player movement/gates, main sim and Blood Woods floor-cover placement.
scripts/lib/data/fauna.js and scripts/fauna.js - FAUNA species/model/gait rows and shared shepherd that moves scene-tagged fauna; main cells attach the shepherd and fauna rows.
scripts/lib/character.js, pack-ui.js, shop.js, trade.js, guildvault.js and board-ui.js - shared Bearer/service logic; guildvault owns vault mutations and board-ui shares trade reads.
scripts/gen/hub-kit.js - shared Wayside Fire transforms, geometry and rock builder reused by hub props; scripts/material-fern-sway.js supplies animated Blood Woods fern material.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/veil/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, sigLand, meleeLand, boltLand, crosswoundFall, burnTick, update; skill impacts route through handlers and burnTick applies Hellwarden burn damage.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body, BEARER; HEIGHT values are metres and position attached enemy effects; crystalbrute uses the gargoyle stone-body stand-in.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; shared ordinary-enemy AI, movement, death and payout helpers, including off-ground falling.
scripts/ui.js - default state-driven HUD/menu/sheets, talent tree, unit frames and enemy portrait/name lookup; scripts/ui/nametag.js renders nametags.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js - boss handlers; scripts/crier.js - onSpawn, quiet, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, roster, create/load/save/remove; scripts/lib/data/talents.js - talent tree/query helpers.
scripts/gen/bw-floor.js - geometry, collider (null); scripts/gen/hub-lamppost.js - FLAME_AT, geometry, collider; scripts/gen/hub-kit.js - modelling/vector helpers.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer combat/progression, quest/reward claims, inventory/gear, arts, attuned shrines, personal vault/vaultRows and talents; packed position and zone feed re-entry/menu context.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement/combat/death, class attacks and skill timers, menu/options scratch, floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; Hellwarden burnUntil is written on foes for delayed burn ticks.
places/main/sim.js - quest/dialog/cut progress and claims; hub NPC/service spawning, packs and boss lifecycle/reset, respawn rows, place mood/track index and ambient audio.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary and mini-boss enemy AI/hp/casts/death, slowUntil movement effect, profile-driven summons and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.

scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat and participant/place boss rows; handlers write lastFall and first world trophy records.

scripts/fauna.js, forest-wisp.js and greeter.js - per-actor wildlife movement, wisp motion/startled presentation, and townsfolk bubble line/cooldown state; fauna data owns species configuration, not live state.
scripts/lib/guildvault.js and guild_vault SQL rows - shared items keyed by realm and Spawn guild; taken rows are guarded, and character inventory owns the member's copy.

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene and x1z0.scene - authored Blood Woods cover/tree locations and Hanging Orchard black-apple tree/light placements, seeds and per-placement parameters; generators provide geometry only.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → scripts/player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options/notes.

defaultPlace veil → player menu; player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml routes selection and Bearer fields hydrate player.state; menu-open Bearers move to veil and places/veil/sim.js rotates menu music.
world controls and controls.js select world/menu touch surfaces; ui.js actions → player.js and its service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.

player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary access gates Hollow Deep via deepDist, and Orchard access includes Rimefast/Vale via rimeDist.
places/main/sim.js quest state advances from player talk/kills/boss flags; chapter stages, boss defeat and service interactions drive shared realm progression.

places/main/sim.js PACKS + combat.yml profiles + models.js body/HEIGHT → enemySpec spawns wax-pack actors; wax-pack runs combat, respawn and eligible payouts/drops using combat/economy/loot data, with kind-specific UI portraits and FX.

Main sim PACKS → Ossuary ash-dead/Kiln Warden, Hollow Deep deepghoul/lurker/crystalbrute/Broodmother and Frostbitten Vale frostdead/rimewolf/icewraith/Frost Jarl; profile summon rows drive mini-boss adds.

Scene fauna rows tagged fauna + fauna.js species values → scripts/fauna.js shepherd update moves wildlife; forest-wisp.js reads home/r/seed and nearby Bearers to drift/flee and change burnStyle; scene rows set wisp color/shape/light.
Candlehold town-* scene rows provide name/title/lines and bubble child → greeter.js shows rotating dialogue; flavor only, not service/quest routing.

Bearer cls → player.js selects models.js BEARER body and implements calling attacks; Gloamstalker ranged attacks and sigVolley → flyArrow spawns scripts/gen/arrow.js geometry and animate sends the arrow to its hit point.

Blood Woods scene rows → bw-floor.js uses seeded params, ground height and veilfall-map.js floor/Orchard distances to scatter non-colliding cover; scene tree rows directly place swaying Blood Woods and black-apple orchard GLBs.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js; hub-lamppost.js builds detailed gothic ironwork with LOD-dependent plinth, fluted post, scroll, chain and crown while retaining FLAME_AT.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js and vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter and road, arena, Wax Veil approach and Abbey forms vary by params, dimensions and seed; most share vf-kit.js.

scripts/gen/fen-*.js - Lanternmere terrain dressing, path, waystones, stump/tree/props and heart structures are parametric seeded scene generators; share fen-kit.js where applicable; fen-tree.js adds smooth low-LOD bark and fine twig fans.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js with cap-gate.js, cap-house.js and cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate share local-frame helpers; dimensions, lighting and seed vary by instance.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing shares scripts/gen/shapes.js and wax palette; split gibbet cages render separately at a top pivot.

scripts/gen/orch-*.js - seeded Hanging Orchard gallows, gibbets, props and trees share orch-kit.js; orch-tree.js adds smooth bark and fine twig/rust-leaf detail at LOD ≤2; eight authored black-apple trees are scene placements across x0z0/x1z0.

Blood Woods: scripts/gen/bw-floor.js cover patches vary by kind, zone, bounds, clearings, seed and LOD; litter is now a denser dark damp mulch-and-leaf carpet. art/bloodwoods/build.py builds varied bloodoak/weepwillow/antlersnag GLBs and art/orchard-apple/build.py with textures.py builds appleA…
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural wax-figure generator; current wax actors use registered models.js bodies.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; talents, shrines, vault and vaultRows persist per Bearer, while proximity flags and vault UI reads are transient.

Talent IDs are branch-tier strings b-t across six tiers; each earlier tier requires 3 points per tier in that branch, and t=5 is a single-rank capstone worth five times its stat; class keystones drive calling-specific behavior.
Wayshrine IDs/coordinates in combat.yml must stay aligned with scene IDs/locations; travel costs 10 copper and refuses while an enemy is within 10 m; Abbey destination obeys player gate.
Personal vault is 18 slots plus up to three purchased rows of nine; guild vault is 27 shared slots per Spawn guild per realm in SQL, separate from character inventory.

Enemy kinds must stay aligned across main sim PACKS, combat.yml, models.js MODELS/HEIGHT, loot.yml/economy.yml, wax-pack.js and ui.js labels/portraits; HEIGHT is metres. Scripted walkers and all five bosses apply downward velocity when ungrounded.

Blood Woods floor rows use generator world origin plus local bounds/clear circles; zone=in/out filters against walkable floor distance and generated cover has no collider. Scene tree placements are separate authored swaying GLBs, not bw-floor output; hub-lamppost FLAME_AT remains the alignment point for its scene light rows.
